description: Source code for a tool that performs batch comparisons of certificate verification results between platform and builtin verifiers, primarily used on Windows, involving network setup, certificate verification, and proto file parsing.

classes.name: CertVerifyImpl
classes.description: Encapsulates certificate verification using a specific CertVerifyProc.

methods.name: VerifyCert
methods.description: Performs certificate verification for a given certificate and hostname.

methods.name: CreateCertVerifyImplFromName
methods.description: Creates a CertVerifyImpl instance based on the provided implementation name.

methods.name: PrintStats
methods.description: Outputs collected statistics about file processing and chain comparisons.

methods.name: GetUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string used for network requests.

methods.name: SetUpOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Initializes network context and fetcher on a dedicated network thread.

methods.name: ShutdownOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Shuts down network context and fetcher on the network thread.
